title: Projective prime-to-ell log-smooth alteration over a trait
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$. A trait here is $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$ for a discrete valuation ring: a Noetherian local domain of dimension one whose maximal ideal is principal. A complete strictly henselian trait has $R$ complete for its maximal-ideal topology and henselian with separably closed residue field (henselian means that every simple root over the residue field of a monic polynomial over $R$ lifts to a root over $R$). Mixed characteristic means that $\operatorname{Frac}R$ has characteristic zero and the residue field has positive characteristic.

Use fs log structures, charts and log morphisms as in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. The canonical log structure on a trait is the subsheaf of $\mathcal O_S$ of sections invertible on its generic point; a uniformizer gives its chart $\mathbf N\to R$. In this statement, log smooth over that trait has its fs chart meaning: etale locally on source and target there are compatible charts $\mathbf N\to P$ with $P$ fine saturated, the group map injective with torsion in its cokernel of finite order invertible on the source, such that the induced scheme map to $S\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[\mathbf N]}\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[P]$ is smooth. Here $\mathbf Z[P]$ is the free abelian group on $P$ with multiplication induced by the monoid law.

Let $S$ be a complete strictly henselian mixed-characteristic trait on which $\ell$ is invertible. Let $X$ be an integral regular scheme, flat and quasi-projective of finite type over $S$ [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-regular-scheme, def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Quasi-projective means that $X$ admits a locally closed immersion into some $\mathbf P^N_S$. There are a finite dominant extension of traits $T\to S$, an integral regular scheme $Y$ quasi-projective of finite type over $T$ and over $S$, an fs log structure $M_Y$ making $(Y,M_Y)\to T$ log smooth for the canonical trait log structure, and a projective dominant $S$-morphism $f:Y\to X$ that is generically finite etale of positive degree $d$ not divisible by $\ell$. Here projective means factoring as a closed immersion into $\mathbf P^m_X$ followed by projection, and generically finite etale means finite etale over a nonempty open of $X$, with $[k(Y):k(X)]=d$. No purity conclusion is included.

source.place: Expose XVI, section 3.7 second paragraph through its last paragraph, printed pp.254--255: semistable G-alteration, ell-Sylow H, tame equivariant modification, quotient over T=S prime/H, and log resolution. Geometric construction only, before applying Theorem 3.6.2 and Proposition 3.5.7; preliminary finite extension to normalize constants in the first paragraph.
